# Copilot instructions — rookit.main.api

## Solution layout

- `MainHub.Api` — the ASP.NET Core API (endpoints, services, validators,
  repositories, domain/persistence types).
- `Shared.Contracts` — the **only** place for public wire contracts (DTOs +
  enums). Referenced by the API via `ProjectReference` and published to the UI
  as an npm package generated by TypeGen.
- `MainHub.Api.IntegrationTests` — integration tests.

## Contracts / DTOs — hard rule

**Never create DTOs or shared enums inside `MainHub.Api` (or the test project).**
All types exchanged with a client — request bodies, responses, list items,
paged results, and their enums — live in `Shared.Contracts`:

- New request/response shape → add a `public` class under
  `Shared.Contracts/DTOs/**` (name it `...Dto`).
- New shared enum → add it to `Shared.Contracts/Enums.cs`.
- Then reference the type from `MainHub.Api` (endpoints/services/validators).

`Shared.Contracts` is the single source of truth: the C# types are the input to
TypeGen, which CI compiles into a TypeScript npm package for the UI. Defining a
contract inside `MainHub.Api` breaks that pipeline because it never reaches the
generated package.

When adding or changing anything under `Shared.Contracts/**`, follow
[.github/instructions/shared-contracts.instructions.md](instructions/shared-contracts.instructions.md).
